newsitem.title: MACAU: LIU CHONG HING BANK OPENS MACAU BRANCH.
newsitem.headline: LIU CHONG HING BANK OPENS MACAU BRANCH.

text.p: Liu Chong Hing Bank Ltd said it opened its first branch in Portuguese-ruled Macau on Friday.
Brian Cheung, a manager of the bank's Shanghai representative office, told Reuters at the opening ceremony the bank planned to expand in the territory in coming years.
"We plan to open three to four sub-branches in Macau in the next few years," he said.
Cheung said the bank planned to offer share broking services to Macau clients who were interested in investing in the Hong Kong stock market. There is no stock exchange in Macau.
He said the bank would act as one of the two bankers handling Macau Jockey Club's off-course betting accounts.
The other bank doing the job is HSBC Holdings Plc's Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd.
